messages:
Sam W.: FYI customer (acct 8421) reports Private control plane mTLS failing after an egress firewall change. Symptoms: intermittent handshake timeouts; packets show client_hello split across TCP segments and NGFW is dropping the second fragment.

Maya R.: Can you paste the tcpdump and the vendor? also did they change MSS/clamp recently?

Sam W.: customer sent a minimal pcap snippet: 
```
15:03:21.123456 IP 10.10.1.5.443 > 172.16.0.10.54321: Flags [P.], seq 1:1461, ack 1, win 29200
15:03:21.123457 IP 10.10.1.5.443 > 172.16.0.10.54321: Flags [P.], seq 1461:2000, ack 1, win 29200
```

Maya R.: That looks like client_hello > 1460 bytes split into two segments. Some appliances configured with TLS inspection but without full TCP reassembly will drop the later fragment.

Devon L.: Vendor = FortiGate 7.0. Customer toggled a policy change last night: enabled 'TLS deep inspection' but disabled 'TCP reassembly' for perf reasons.

Sam W.: Customer also ran openssl against the CP and saw timeouts:
```
openssl s_client -connect controlplane.redwood.internal:443 -tls1_3 -servername controlplane.redwood.internal -cert client.pem -key key.pem
CONNECTED(00000003)
140736...:error:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert protocol version:SSL/record/rec_layer_s3.c:...
```

Maya R.: Repro strategy we advised: capture full pcap on client and control plane, and try MSS clamp / enable reassembly. Quick checks: `ip route get`, `ip link` for MTU, and `tcpdump -i <if> -s 0 -w trace.pcap host <control-ip>`.

Sam W.: Customer enabled `TCP reassembly` and applied MSS clamping to 1440 on the egress policy -> immediate success, handshake completes every time.

Devon L.: Long-term mitigation options: 1) add control plane IP ranges to appliance passthrough/allowlist so TLS is not inspected or broken into fragments for inspection; 2) require full TCP reassembly on inspection nodes; 3) MSS clamp on egress to avoid fragmentation.

Maya R.: CLI hints we gave customer to find dropped fragments:
```
# Linux: show dropped fragments/conn resets
sudo iptables -L -v -n --line-numbers
sudo cat /proc/net/netstat | grep Fragment
# Forti example
diagnose firewall iprope debug 2
config firewall policy
  show
end
```

Sam W.: Filed request with fw-team to add CP prefixes to passthrough and to audit reassembly flags. Customer will keep reassembly enabled for now and we've requested vendor case.

netops-bot: Incident created INC-2025-8421, assignee: devon.l

Devon L.: Summary for postmortem: root cause = NGFW dropped second fragment of large TLS client_hello because TCP reassembly was off and MSS/MTU mismatch allowed fragmentation. Workarounds = enable reassembly, MSS clamp, or passthrough rule. KB draft will be posted to support docs.

Maya R.: @Sam W. please attach the pcap and Forti debug output to INC-2025-8421 so KB can include examples.

Sam W.: Attached pcap, Forti config export, and vendor case #12345678. :thumbsup:
